about.title: About this newsroom
paragraphs: This site is built for entertainment news — the headlines, trends, and culture stories moving film, TV, music, and digital media. Think of it as a fast, visual news desk for people who live in the feed.

We publish latest reads, trending roundups, and deeper features so you can stay current without the noise. Studio production work lives on a separate track; here the focus is coverage, context, and what’s catching fire right now.
